question: How small a nested leave-one-out-ranked component pool closes the cue-source-to-weight-reader program?
construction: Each arm is the union of the frozen donor top20 and the first N sites in the frozen component-deletion ranking. Rank27 is the preregistered 90%-importance candidate pool. No ranking or membership is recomputed.
selection_rule: Select the jointly feasible arm with the fewest allowed components, breaking ties by arm order. The coordinate, target, and control thresholds are exactly the layer-band v1 thresholds under both cross-fits.

predictions.pred_a_authority_self_clamp_finiteness_a: authorities replay, no-source self-clamp is exact, values are finite, and <=77 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_a_strictly_pruned_prefix_is_joint: some arm below rank110 meets all coordinate, behavior, and control thresholds under both fits
predictions.pred_d_selected_arm_contains_frozen_90pc: the selected arm contains every component in the frozen rank27 candidate pool
predictions.pred_e_selected_arm_is_crossfit_stable: selected minimum-coordinate projections differ by <=0.05 and per-task behavior projections differ by <=0.05 across fits

decision: A passing prefix is the next executable circuit support. If only rank110 passes, single-deletion importance is not compositionally sufficient and grouped interaction search replaces this nested greedy construction.
